ruling: Remove Tier 1 of _enhance_artist (MusicBrainz name search that auto-links an MBID onto an MBID-less artist). Artists gain an MBID only through release / recording enrichment (ArtistRepository.upsert_musicbrainz_artist). An MBID-less artist reaching mb_enrichment is a logic bug, not a work item.
rationale: Open question 3, option A. Unreachable in production: upsert_local_artist inserts needs_enhancement FALSE and MB artists always carry an MBID (dev DB: 3,990 LOCAL artists, 0 queued). Linking a local artist would not help matching because its files carry no MusicBrainz ids. Removing it also retires the latent UNIQUE-collision retry loop (AUD-019) and AUD-020's C901.
supersedes: mb_enrichment_tasks._enhance_artist docstring contract 'Tier 1 (no MBID): name search -> score gate -> fill fields or bail out'

ruling: There is no async repository or query layer yet. Raw SQL on an endpoint's async connection stays where it is (routers, identity_resolution_service.persist_manual_match) until one exists; moving it behind the repository layer is deferred, not rejected.
rationale: Every repository is synchronous. Moving an INSERT or a read query that runs inside the endpoint's async transaction onto a sync repository would split the transaction; creating the first async query layer is a separate design decision. Lance chose extraction-only for AUD-054 (pass 6) and AUD-004 (pass 7).

ruling: Only mb_enrichment_task and library_enrichment_task share a task-run lifecycle envelope (backend/tasks/_task_run.task_run). library_scan_task, library_scan_files_task (watcher), ingestion_task and library_hash_backfill_task keep their own envelopes, and task_failure_telemetry keeps its FAILED-only contract.
rationale: A gate-0 inventory (2026-09-29) found the six envelopes differ in observable rows (watcher and ingestion write no SystemLog; library_scan's failed log has no traceback; FAILED payload keys differ), in connection ownership (hash backfill keeps progress on its non-autocommit batch transaction by design), and in how a chained task's failure is attributed. Unifying them would change behaviour. The enrichment pair is the one shape AUD-025's evidence covers (9 shared commits). Lance ruled 2026-09-29; the behaviour differences are addressed separately by declared fixes (see AUD-R012 when recorded).
supersedes: AUD-021/AUD-025 recommendation to extend the envelope to all tasks

ruling: Fixed by the AUD-025 PR (branch refactor/aud-025-enrichment-task-run): mb_enrichment_task and library_enrichment_task run inside backend/tasks/_task_run.task_run, which owns the autocommit progress connection, RUNNING + started log, COMPLETED + completed log, and FAILED (processed/total from read_progress) + failed log with traceback. Becomes ACTIVE-fixed with its merge commit.
rationale: Pure refactor: gate-1 snapshots of the full TaskProgress/SystemLog row sequences are byte-identical; library_enrichment's chained mb_enrichment_task enqueue stays outside the envelope as before.

ruling: Fixed by the AUD-025 PR: with its envelope in task_run, mb_enrichment_task no longer exceeds PLR0915 (was 49 > 40). Becomes ACTIVE-fixed with its merge commit.
